subject: Insurance
title: Cyber Insurance Explosion
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Cyber Insurance Explosion.

hook.text: Cyber insurance premiums grew 50% in a single year to $7.2 billion.

buildup.text: A single data breach costs an average of $4.45 million. Ransomware attacks can shut down operations for weeks.

discovery.text: Cyber policies cover ransom payments, forensic investigation, legal liability.

climax.text: Cyber insurance is the fastest-growing segment in the industry—driven by a threat that didn't exist two decades ago.

quiz.question: What is the average cost of a single data breach?
